info.name: Tugas 2 - Taxi Fare Model API (Databricks Model Serving)
info.description:
Health check + inference tests for the Databricks Model Serving endpoint that serves the best MLflow model (workspace.tugas2.taxi_fare_model@champion).

Set collection variables `host`, `endpoint_name`, and `token` (a Databricks personal access token - keep it in the Postman *current value* only, never commit it).

Input schema (from silver_taxi): trip_distance (mi), trip_duration_min, pickup_hour (0-23), pickup_dow (1=Sun..7=Sat), pickup_zip, dropoff_zip. Output: predicted fare_amount (USD).

Requests 4-5 connect the Google Drive dataset to the API: request 4 downloads My Drive/tugas2/nyctaxi_trips.csv (public link, no auth - the Databricks token is NOT sent to Google), validates it and builds features for `gdrive_sample_size` evenly spaced trips exactly like silver_taxi (duration in minutes rounded to 2 decimals, hour, dayofweek 1=Sun..7=Sat, missing zip -> 0, silver expectations applied). Request 5 sends those trips to the model and compares predictions with the real fare_amount. Note: these trips come from the same source the model was trained on, so the error shown is an in-sample sanity check, not a held-out evaluation.

exec: pm.test('Serves the champion taxi fare model', () => pm.expect(body.config.served_entities[0].entity_name).to.include('taxi_fare_model'));
pm.test('Response is valid JSON with predictions', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.have.property('predictions'));
pm.test('One numeric prediction per input row', () => { pm.expect(p).to.have.lengthOf(3); p.forEach(v => pm.expect(v).to.be.a('number')); });
pm.test('Predicted fares are positive', () => p.forEach(v => pm.expect(v).to.be.above(0)));
pm.test('Drive returned the CSV, not an HTML page', () => pm.expect(lines[0]).to.not.match(/^\s*</));
// Build model features like silver_taxi. Timestamps are naive 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings: parse as UTC so hour/day never shift with the local timezone.
const ts = s => { const [d, t] = s.split(' '); const [Y, M, D] = d.split('-').map(Number); const [h, m, x] = t.split(':').map(Number); return Date.UTC(Y, M - 1, D, h, m, x); };
for (let i = 1; i < lines.length && rows.length < N; i += step) {
const [pu, dof, dist, fare, pz, dz] = lines[i].split(',');
const t0 = ts(pu), dur = Math.round((ts(dof) - t0) / 600) / 100;  // minutes, 2 decimals
if (!(+dist > 0 && +dist < 100 && +fare > 0 && +fare < 500 && dur > 0 && dur <= 180)) continue;  // silver expectations

item.name: 5. Predict fare - trips pulled from Google Drive

exec: pm.test('Predictions are positive numbers', () => p.forEach(v => { pm.expect(v).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(v).to.be.above(0); }));
const mae = p.reduce((s, v, i) => s + Math.abs(v - fares[i]), 0) / p.length;
pm.test(`Mean absolute error vs actual fare is below $3 (got $${mae.toFixed(2)})`, () => pm.expect(mae).to.be.below(3));
